comments: 41132e2c: This routine manages events related to patient admissions, transfers, and discharges.
e2bb87c1: Initialize variables.
bd8b71d8: Set DGONE flag to indicate process has started.
1caca2f8: Iterate through patient movements and process each one.
71dc9c6a: Final cleanup before quitting the routine.
94ad8e9f: End of the main entry point.
10c7ae46: START processes an individual patient movement event.
664b8d5a: Determine corresponding Admission/Transfer/Discharge (ATD) episode.
b505d0a5: Determine the type of patient movement.
4a1527f9: If movement type is admission and there's no prior movement, quit processing.
e0e163ae: Display update message, if applicable.
4b1dc4d2: Reset DGONE flag after first update message.
37371ed1: Call DIK to delete incomplete records.
3f772026: Assign ward information.
5803c285: Set division based on ward information.
7f38ea2e: Quit if division setup is incomplete.
c7987c58: Display 'updating incomplete records' message if flag is set.
a3ee0e7c: Find the first Inpatient Site file number for service initiated from PTF.
1f018286: Call DIS routine to process the discharge.
64d9cce9: Delete entries in the IRT record file associated with an admission.
d547cc0e: Cleanup variables used by DIK.
5437dc15: The DIS routine handles discharge processing.
6f3fd896: Declare local variable DR for later use.
abe5ac3b: Set the admission ID for current processing.
11ba6567: Check for existing IRT records for the admission.
d199a159: If an IRT record is found, set DGJTDA to its IEN.
a56de695: Process changes if the movement type is transfer and conditions are met.
d34d01a5: Handle new IRT records for admissions and transfers.
06b57fda: Delete IRT record if previous movement was admission and no current movement.
28e7c93d: Handle changes for transfer movements.
d89d9fec: For discharge movements, update the discharge event.
6ff41b08: On discharge, create a new event if previous movement was admission and no current movement.
dc0b68d2: Quit processing for discharge movements.
3950b482: Set change admission flag if an IRT record exists for admission.
3bf5d4da: Process change if service transfer differs between previous and current.
72ee6368: Handle changes if there's a difference in specialty service.
7c9454be: Cleanup variables and quit the DISQ routine.
b96e53ef: The NEW routine creates a new IRT record.
bbcaa8b5: Determine the most recent ATD episode for the patient.
003936cf: Retrieve division time-sensitive settings.
c8b796f1: Set ward information based on the ward ID.
80a6c453: Determine service connected to the ward.
4b7c0a70: Set service variable for IRT record.
8c84f29b: Define default doctor for IRT record.
062e8940: Set admitting doctor based on division settings.
d372d185: Quit processing for certain movement types.
8823ff76: Do not proceed if DGJTCA is set, indicating a change admission.
793f8fdb: Create a new IRT record in the file.
64db8615: Set the status of the IRT record to 'INCOMPLETE'.
e02fe899: If new record creation was successful, set DA for further processing.
c3b947cc: Update the IRT record with movement and division information.
0def0681: Perform the database update with the information.
73934e3f: Cleanup and exit NEW routine.
c1d07288: Update ward and division information for admission, transfer, and discharge.
b340475c: Finalize the update of the IRT record.
a1061950: Call DISQ for cleanup.
b54f525f: End of the FILE routine.
84f43d29: The DOC routine handles document processing.
a02f53ea: Retrieve document setting based on division.
f839ffb4: Set document fields based on division settings.
ff45c4fd: Quit DOC routine.
c9455d00: CHNG routine handles updating of existing IRT records.
c11b0ecf: Check if the movement has an associated discharge.
add86427: Update the treatment date with the discharge date if present.
a89280cb: Set the treatment date in the IRT record.
